description: Chiggi Patches v1.9.3 — fixes the Nutrilio food search bar: it no longer overlaps the meal-time chip, and typing now filters by food name instead of hiding every chip. SonyLIV (com.sonyliv 6.23.1) + Nutrilio (net.nutrilio 1.20.2). Nutrilio Change app name + package name default on (Nutrilio Morphe / net.nutrilio.morphe).
